title: Custom Nolita Wristlet 24 With Floral Rivets
material: Polished pebble leather and smooth leather

descriptionHtml:
Pre-owned and now (re)loved, this Nolita Wristlet 24 is a very special Coach custom design inspired by our commitment to rethinking and reducing our impact on the planet. Saved from the landfill, this gently-worn bag was lovingly repaired and transformed by our in-house craftspeople who added clever details to give it a second life. It’s completely one-of-a-kind, and comes with its own unique set of charms. Wear it, love it, pass it on. Reimagined by Rose Oliva with tonal hand-laced whipstitching for a distinctive touch, this zip-top style has been expertly cleaned, conditioned and restored. Our talented craftspeople Fernando Gutierrez and Yngrid Pichardo Baez embellished the piping with sleek whipstitching, attached a whipstitched short strap with dogleashes and anchors, repaired edgestain, then added a playful repurposed charm. Named for the hip downtown New York neighborhood, the Nolita Wristlet 24 features a convertible chain strap that allows you to carry it as a clutch or top handle. An ideal grab-and-go style, it's crafted of polished pebble leather embellished with floral rivets.

Product Specifications

  • Material: Polished pebble leather and smooth leather
  • Lining: Fabric lining
  • Closure: Zip-top closure
  • Organization: Inside open pocket
